instruction.text: Jolie’s garden is a square and each side has a length of 11 m. Help her work out the area of her garden.
instruction.sound: Jolie’s garden is a square and each side has a length of 11 metres. Help her work out the area of her garden.

atoms.b: The area of Jolie’s garden is <mat><gap>121</gap>`m`^2</mat>.

instruction.text: Jolie now wants to work out the total area of her living room and her kitchen. Both rooms are squares. The living room has a side length of 6 m and the kitchen has a side length of 9 m. Work out the total area of both rooms.
instruction.sound: Jolie now wants to work out the total area of her living room and her kitchen. Both rooms are squares. The living room has a side length of 6 metres and the kitchen has a side length of 9 metres. Work out the total area of both rooms.

atoms.b: The area of the living room is <mat><gap>36</gap>m^2</mat> and the area of the kitchen is <mat><gap>81</gap>m^2</mat>.
The combined area of the rooms is <mat><gap>117</gap>m^2</mat>.

instruction.text: Jolie recently put up 3 paintings on her wall. Both the wall and the paintings are squares. The wall has a side length of 6 m, and each painting has a side length of 1 m. Work out how much space she has left.
instruction.sound: Jolie recently put up 3 paintings on her wall. Both the wall and the paintings are squares. The wall has a side length of 6 metres, and each painting has a side length of 1 metre. Work out how much space she has left.

atoms.b: The paintings take up a total area of <mat>3*<gap>1</gap>m^2=<gap>3</gap>m^2</mat>.
The area of the wall is <mat><gap>36</gap>m^2</mat>.
The total area of the wall remaining is <mat><gap>33</gap>m^2</mat>.

instruction.text: Jolie’s house is in the shape of a cube, and each side of the house is 10 m long. What is the volume of her house?
instruction.sound: Jolie’s house is in the shape of a cube, and each side of the house is 10 metres long. What is the volume of her house?
